WHO WE ARE

About us

Welcome to Gaddiwala Showroom, your trusted partner in finding high-quality, reliable vehicles and complete automotive service solutions.

Located conveniently at Faizpur Interchange, M-2 Motorway, Sharqpur Road, Sheikhupura, we pride ourselves on offering a wide range of cars that cater to the diverse needs of our customers. Whether you are looking for a family-friendly car, a fuel-efficient hybrid model, or an executive luxury vehicle, our expert team is here to guide you every step of the way. We are committed to delivering exceptional service, ensuring that every customer drives away with a car that meets their expectations and budget.

At Gaddiwala Showroom, integrity, transparency, and customer satisfaction are at the heart of everything we do. We carefully inspect and maintain all our vehicles through our on-site workshop, providing you with the assurance of quality, verified auction sheets, and complete peace of mind.
